info.title: data-cleaning-pipeline implemented API
info.description: Implemented Java /api routes and protected Java/Python internal routes. Includes schema3 v3-disk logical bindings/21rules, exact decimals, cursor pages, explicit audited retention, event ledger and execution deadlines. Historical schema1 engines/19rules and capped listings remain compatible; legacy lists/upload aliases are marked deprecated. Java is the sole browser business origin; Python internal operations override servers to Compose python-api:8000. Ownership is enforced server-side; ADMIN may read all tasks while task writes/file/rule operations remain owner-scoped. GET /actuator/health is infrastructure-managed and excluded from application controllers. Generation: python scripts/generate_openapi.py; verification: python scripts/generate_openapi.py --check.

post.summary: Acquire current attempt lease
post.description: Trusted worker only. V3 UUID required; absent UUID400. Stale attempt/terminal/CANCELING returns execute:false (safe to ACK). Already RUNNING live lease409: retry/requeue, not ACK. Successful claim sets RUNNING/progress1 and returns leaseToken. One task per worker process; prefetch1. Global/per-user running slot exhaustion409 RUNNING_CAPACITY; queue delivery is delayed. Response carries immutable executionTimeoutSeconds/cancelGraceSeconds and leaseSeconds.

post.description: Current leaseToken and attempt UUID fence live attempts. v3-disk additionally requires eventId UUID and monotonic eventSeq>=1. Same event ID/seq+identical canonical payload is replay-safe; reuse with changed payload409. Stale/terminal/out-of-order events are recorded but cannot regress state. SUCCEEDED requires identity/conservation-checked report and exact nonempty artifacts. Deadline-expired successes become FAILED/TASK_TIMEOUT. Cancellation wins over late RUNNING/SUCCEEDED.

SequentialRule.description: Historical schema1 execution shape:19 columns/column rules with optional id/enabled defaults. No logical fields or decimal dtype. Select v3-disk/schema3 for the new logical-field contract.

Rules.description: Historical schema1 strict19 columns/column rule array; empty valid, <=100000 UTF-8 bytes. Preserved for existing saves and v2-phased execution.

TaskStatus.description: CANCELLED is normalized to CANCELED on public reads. Active quota counts QUEUED/RUNNING/CANCELING. Terminal attempts never regress.

TaskInputSnapshot.description: Immutable per-task source snapshot. fileId/fields may be absent on legacy snapshots; new Java snapshots include them.

TaskCreate.description: Schema version must match selected immutable rule version. Schema3 requires explicit fieldBindings and v3-disk; schema1 defaults v3-sequential when engine omitted. parseVersion detects a stale binding after reparse (409 PARSE_VERSION_CHANGED). Unsupported combinations are rejected, never silently migrated.

Task.description: Task view; attemptId/currentAttemptId identify the current UUID attempt. Numeric attempt is retained for compatibility and artifact paths.

Attempt.description: Historical attempt metadata remains readable after retry; attempt/attemptNo are exact aliases.

FillStatistics.description: Keys are stable fN field IDs; numeric invalid samples are excluded, mode includes nonmissing typed values.

factor.description: Finite JSON number; NaN and Infinity are rejected.

statistics.description: Historical statistics use sampleCount/invalidValues. Disk fills use fN->{validValueCount,excludedInvalidValueCount,missingValueCount,fillValue:{type,value,...},sum?,scale?,rounding?,unroundedMean?}; disk IQR uses exact decimal-text q1/q3/lower/upper and counts; dedup uses distinctKeys/keepPolicy/nullsEqual.

RuleReport.description: V2 has phase. V3 has ruleId/status and action metrics; disabled entries have zero metrics and executionOrder=null.

validOutputRows.description: Final output records with no quality issue.

flaggedOutputRows.description: Final output records with mark/null issues, including nulled values later filled.

finalRemovedRows.description: Unique source records removed exactly once.

duplicateRemovedRows.description: Subset of final removals attributed to deduplicate.

outlierHandledRows.description: Unique source records acted on by range/IQR; may overlap other event metrics.

missingFilledCells.description: Rule x source record x field events changing missing to nonmissing; repeated refill counts again.

typeConversionFailedCells.description: Cast failure events, including repeated cast rules on the same field.

issueRows.description: Unique source records with >=1 issue, including removed records.

finalRemovalByRule.description: Rule ID -> first actual unique removals; sum equals finalRemovedRows. Only rules that removed rows appear.

Report.description: Historical reports remain readable. Schema3 disk execution preserves strict order with global exact statistics, top-level quality/conservation metrics, unique final deletion attribution, per-rule stage rows/duration and scratch peak. inputRows=outputRows+finalRemovedRows; outputRows=validOutputRows+flaggedOutputRows. Event counters can overlap; changedCells records actual transforms at each rule, including records removed later.

_before_value.description: Typed JSON string of the value before that rule; dedup uses a typed key-field record. Original source columns are also retained separately.

V3DirtyTrace.description: CSV export schema, one row per issue plus immutable original source columns. V2 exports only the first six metadata columns. Source row is a 1-based logical data record, excluding header; embedded CSV newlines do not increment it. Disk engine includes stable SHA256 recordId (file+parse snapshot+sheet+logical ordinal), source_record_number, removed_by_rule_id and attempt_id. Retries preserve source identity.

TaskMessage.description: RabbitMQ envelope: historical schema1 engines remain compatible; schema3 requires v3-disk, UUID attemptId and explicit logical bindings. Java freezes input/parseVersion/rules/bindings/limits in its transactional outbox. Worker claims the attempt before any heavy processing. Numeric attempt remains the artifact namespace. Encoded payload<=128KiB.

Claim.description: V3 requires matching attemptId UUID; numeric attempt retained. V2 may omit UUID but requires numeric attempt.

WorkerEvent.description: Current leaseToken and attempt UUID fence live attempts. v3-disk additionally requires eventId UUID and monotonic eventSeq>=1. Same event ID/seq+identical canonical payload is replay-safe; reuse with changed payload409. Stale/terminal/out-of-order events are recorded but cannot regress state. SUCCEEDED requires identity/conservation-checked report and exact nonempty artifacts. Deadline-expired successes become FAILED/TASK_TIMEOUT. Cancellation wins over late RUNNING/SUCCEEDED.

objectKey.description: No .. or backslash; only MinIO raw object keys, never URLs.
No .., backslash or colon. Download bounded to 256 MiB independently of stat size.

DiskRule.description: Schema3:21 strict rule types. id/enabled required; logical field IDs, exact typed scalars, decimal precision<=38/scale<=12/HALF_UP. Configured order executes over current survivors. Additional semantic validation enforces parameter dependencies, type compatibility, safe regex, field lifecycle and decimal domain.

DiskRules.description: Serialized rule array <=100000 UTF-8 bytes; IDs unique. Disabled rules remain validated. Global operations use SQLite indexes over all current survivors, independent of batch boundaries.

LogicalFields.description: Unique logical IDs declared by the reusable rule set.

FieldBindings.description: Explicit injective logical ID -> immutable input fN mapping. Every referenced logical ID must be declared and bound. No implicit name/position matching.

rules.description: Map of the21 rule type names to authoritative Draft2020-12 definitions.

jsonSchema.description: Complete Draft2020-12 array schema with oneOf and $defs; this value is a JSON Schema document, not an OpenAPI reference.

LegacyRuleSetInput.description: Compatible historical schema1 save contract: strict19 columns/column rules; Java validates these through the historical Python gateway. Omitting metadata preserves existing clients.

SnapshotField.description: Immutable ordered fN/name parse field; optional preview/type metadata is preserved. Names must be unique and nonreserved.

DiskTaskInputSnapshot.description: Immutable per-task source snapshot. fileId/fields may be absent on legacy snapshots; new Java snapshots include them.

TaskRetry.description: Optional optimistic guard; mismatch409 ATTEMPT_CHANGED. Retry keeps immutable task snapshots and creates a new attempt.

PublicPreflightRequest.description: Either a saved rule version or an explicit unsaved schema3 configuration. Java checks file ownership, successful parse and optional parseVersion before internal preflight.

RuleValidationResponse.description: Schema3 returns normalized logical-field rules, without requiring task bindings. Historical validation returns valid only.

RetentionPolicy.description: Defaults to dry-run. Pre-upgrade objects are protected unless includeExisting explicitly enabled; active references/download leases and grace periods remain protected.

RetentionPolicyUpdate.description: Partial update. Turning enabled on requires confirmation ENABLE_RETENTION; turning includeExisting on requires INCLUDE_EXISTING_DATA. Enable them in separate requests when both transitions are required.

afterObjectKey.description: Optional exclusive lexical starting key for an initial scan.

continuation.description: Signed 24-hour continuation bound to admin, protocol version and unchanged original scope; copy nextContinuation into the same scope to build another dry-run plan.

RetentionScope.description: Omitted/empty lists select the available catalog; explicit lists are applied before catalog/log SQL limits. Discovery scans at most1000 total objects or5seconds between object-store calls; one network call may exceed that interval. Planning itself deletes nothing; use scan.nextContinuation until truncated=false.

RetentionRun.description: Camel-case fields are primary; underscore aliases remain for compatibility.
